_comment: Copy this to config.json and edit. Everything here is optional; the radar works with no config at all.

accaCareers._comment: Official ACCA Careers RSS search for Ireland. No key required.

adzuna._comment: Free keys from https://developer.adzuna.com. Adds salary data and wider coverage.

jobsIreland._comment: Official Department of Social Protection vacancies. No key required.

officialEmployers._comment: Official Ireland careers feeds for Apple, Amazon, Microsoft, KPMG, Deloitte, PwC and EY. No key required.

localSearch._comment: Town-by-town searching for where you actually live, plus work-from-home searches. Change cities if you move; also update regionKeys in src/views.js. Searches 45 brands by default; set brands to an array to customise or [] to disable brand searches. Also searches 190 local shops, hospitality and campus employer names by default; set shops to an array to customise or [] to disable these.

employers._comment: Public careers boards. Add any company here to follow it directly.

retailEmployers._comment: Direct public vacancies and full descriptions. Dunnes and Aldi remain covered through general searches because their direct sites restrict automated access.
